jobs.title: ServiceNow QA Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Job Description BETSOLs team designs and runs software license tracking on ServiceNow SAM Professional. For each software publisher brought into scope, the team analyses contracts, models entitlements and consumption, and delivers a custom publisher view and dashboard that shows licenses owned, licenses consumed and the resulting compliance position. The publishers we work with span SaaS and enterprise software, each with its own license metrics, SKUs and data sources. We are looking for a QA engineer who can test ServiceNow SAM implementation end to end and keep growing the test automation. You will validate the calculations behind every license number, to prove that dashboards match the underlying report data, and turn repeatable checks into automated scripts so that releases move from development to UAT to production quickly. You will work closely with ServiceNow developers, business analysts and project managers, and with business stakeholders during UAT. Key responsibilities Testing SAM publisher implementations Review publisher analysis and stories, then write test scenarios and test cases that trace back to the agreed requirements and expected dashboard output. Validate entitlement and consumption logic: rights owned, rights consumed, rights available and rights needed, license metrics (for example User Subscription versus Resource Consumption) and custom SKUs created for usage that standard SKUs do not cover. Verify calculation rules such as contract term calculation with date tolerance, unit price by billing frequency, weighted average price across entitlements and ratchet behaviour where increases are applied and decreases are not. Test server-side components on the custom SAM report table, including business rules, script includes, scheduled jobs that run by product group, and audit and data-fix scripts. Reconcile dashboard values against report and source records for each product group, and validate data built from vendor exports and admin API extracts (deduplication, scoping by site and contract line). Run functional, regression and UAT support cycles across the development, test and production instances. Building and running test automation Extend the existing SAM automation framework and test scripts, and deliver items on the SAM test automation roadmap against agreed timelines. Automate regression suites for recurring publisher patterns so developers can run them when QA capacity is tight. Use the ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF) and server-side scripts to automate data and calculation checks. Keep scripts maintainable, documented and reusable across publishers. Quality process and reporting Log, track and retest defects; record evidence and keep test case documents current. Produce a QA sign-off document for each release with test case counts, pass results, defects raised and fixes verified, before promotion to UAT. Support stakeholder reviews of dashboards before production, and fold their feedback into validation before deployment. Take part in sprint ceremonies, estimate QA effort and raise risks to delivery early. Qualifications Required qualifications Minimum 2 years of hands-on QA experience on the ServiceNow platform, within at least 3 years of overall software testing experience. Working knowledge of ServiceNow SAM Professional or Software Asset Management concepts: entitlements, license metrics, software models, reconciliation and compliance. Practical test automation experience, ideally with ServiceNow ATF, and enough JavaScript to read and write server-side scripts and GlideRecord queries. Strong data validation skills: comfortable reconciling numbers across tables, reports and spreadsheets, and explaining where a figure comes from. Experience writing structured test cases and sign-off reports, and using Jira and a test management tool such as Zephyr. Clear written and spoken English, with the confidence to walk stakeholders through test results and to discuss your own past work in depth. jobs.description: Scope: Design, build, and evolve cloud-native platform capabilities leveraging Kubernetes, Golang, and Azure. Develop platform automation and reusable services while driving scalability, reliability, security, and operational excellence across engineering teams. About the Role: We are looking for an experienced Staff Software Engineer - Platform Engineering to design, build, and evolve the next generation of cloud-native platform capabilities. This role requires deep technical expertise in Kubernetes, Networking, and Go (Golang) to develop scalable, secure, and high-performance platform solutions that empower engineering teams. As a Staff Engineer, you will provide technical leadership across multiple initiatives, drive architecture and design decisions, mentor engineers, and be accountable for the successful delivery of critical platform engineering projects. You will work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, and SRE teams to build reusable frameworks, automation, and platform services that improve developer productivity, reliability, and operational excellence. Networking (Expert): Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, Load Balancing, Ingress, CNI, Network Policies, routing, firewalls, and troubleshooting distributed networking. Go (Golang): Extensive experience building scalable backend services, Kubernetes Operators, controllers, and automation frameworks. Kubernetes Operators: Proven experience developing and maintaining Kubernetes Operators using Operator SDK or Kubebuilder. CI/CD & GitOps: Strong experience with GitHub workflows, CI/CD pipeline design and implementation, and GitOps practices using Argo CD. Platform Engineering: Experience designing and building scalable, high-performance platform frameworks, internal developer platforms, and reusable engineering services. Technical Leadership: Demonstrated ownership of architecture and technical decisions, accountability for team deliverables, and experience conducting code reviews and mentoring engineers. Knowledge of cloud security best practices, including IAM, Managed Identities, Azure Key Vault/Secrets Management, RBAC, network security, and Zero Trust principles. Hands-on experience with GitOps workflows and deployment automation. Experience implementing observability solutions using Elastic Stack, Logstash, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, or similar monitoring and logging platforms. Familiarity with service mesh technologies such as Istio. Exposure to multi-cluster Kubernetes, disaster recovery, backup and restore strategies, and platform resilience. Experience with performance optimization, capacity planning, scalability, and cost optimization for cloud-native platforms. Knowledge of container security, image scanning, vulnerability management, policy enforcement, and software supply chain security. Key Responsibilities: Lead the architecture, design, and development of scalable platform engineering solutions. Design and build reusable platform frameworks, services, and automation to improve developer experience and operational efficiency. Drive technical decisions and establish engineering best practices across platform teams. Strong ownership mindset with accountability for technical decisions, architecture, and delivery outcomes. jobs.description: Software Engineer, AI-Enabled Services (GCP)Role Summary We are seeking a Software Engineer to build and ship production-ready AI-enabled services on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Our agents and workflows are assembled in a low-code agent builder and n8n. This role focuses on the high-code layer underneath: MCP servers, APIs, and application services that give those agents and workflows secure, reliable access to enterprise systems and data.The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with a rigorous approach to quality and the ability to work directly with partners. You will translate business needs from technical and non-technical stakeholders into well-designed, well-tested services, and you will hold a high bar for what "production-ready" means. Key Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain high-code services on GCP, including MCP servers, APIs, and supporting application services, using Cloud Run, GKE, Pub/Sub, Cloud Functions, and related capabilities. Build integrations with enterprise systems, APIs, databases, and event streams that low-code agents and n8n workflows can use reliably. Own quality for the products you build: define test strategies, write automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests, and establish release-readiness criteria. Validate the behavior of AI-enabled workflows, including tool invocation, error handling, edge cases, and regressions, and help define evaluation approaches for non-deterministic outputs. Design, develop, and manage relational database schemas, queries, migrations, and performance tuning in support of application and workflow needs. Meet with partners, both technical and non-technical, to gather requirements, clarify goals, and walk through designs. Translate their needs into clear technical specifications, and explain trade-offs, risks, and status in language each audience understands. jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer Automation
jobs.description: Senior QA Engineer Automation Experience: 4+ Years Job Location: WFH / Hybrid No. of Positions: Multiple Qualifications: B.Tech / M.Tech / MCA or equivalent in Computer Science or a related field Work Timings: 1:30 PM IST to 10:30 PM IST About the Role We are looking for a skilled and versatile Senior QA Engineer with hands-on expertise in Web UI Automation, API Testing, and Application Security/Penetration Testing. In this dual-focus role, you will be responsible for ensuring both the functional excellence and security resilience of modern web applications and microservices. You will build and scale automated test suites while systematically identifying application-level security flaws, running vulnerability scans, and performing manual and automated penetration testing across web and API layers. Key Responsibilities Test Automation & API Testing Design, build, and maintain scalable automated test suites for web applications using modern UI frameworks (e.g., Playwright, Cypress, Selenium). Architect automated end-to-end API test suites for REST and GraphQL services (payload validation, contract testing, response times, auth token flows). Perform functional, regression, integration, cross-browser, and database verification testing. Embed UI and API automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins) for continuous feedback and zero-defect releases. Write complex SQL queries to validate backend data integrity and system states. Security & Penetration Testing Conduct vulnerability assessments and web application penetration testing aligned with OWASP Top 10 and OWASP API Security Top 10. Execute both dynamic application security testing (DAST) and manual penetration testing to uncover vulnerabilities such as SQL injection, XSS, Broken Object-Level Authorization (BOLA/IDOR), CSRF, and SSRF. Perform API security audits focusing on authentication, authorization mechanisms (OAuth 2.0, JWT, API Keys), rate limiting, and parameter tampering. Integrate automated security scanning tools (e.g., OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite, Snyk) into the DevSecOps/CI-CD workflow. Document security findings, assign severity scores (CVSS), and partner directly with development teams to triage, reproduce, and verify remediation. Collaboration & Quality Ownership Participate actively in Agile ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Standups, Grooming) to ensure early threat modeling and quality planning. Analyze system logs and telemetry using tools like Splunk, Datadog, or ELK to conduct root cause analysis (RCA) on functional defects and security alerts. Maintain clear technical documentation, test strategies, and security vulnerability reports. Skills, Knowledge, and Experience Required Technical Skills 4+ years of core QA experience covering functional, regression, API, and automation testing. 1–2+ years of practical experience in Security Testing and Web/API Penetration Testing. Strong hands-on proficiency in building automation frameworks with tools like Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or Karate. Solid experience in API testing (functional and security) using tools such as Postman, RestAssured, Insomnia, or Karate. Proven proficiency with web security assessment tools such as Burp Suite Professional/Community, OWASP ZAP, Nmap, or SQLmap. In-depth understanding of OWASP Top 10 and OWASP API Security Top 10 vulnerabilities and remediation strategies. Strong command of SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL, etc.) for data validation and backend verification. Solid experience with version control (Git) workflows (branching, pull requests, conflict resolution). Working knowledge of CI/CD integration (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) for running automated tests and automated security scans. 4-9 Yrs Software testing, Senior, Quality assurance, UI Automation, UI, ETL, Senior QA, Penetration

jobs.title: Lead Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: Job Summary You'll join our Machine Learning and Data Science experts within the Applied Tech AI team. This team is part of Bain's digital capabilities practice, which includes experts in analytics, engineering, product management, and design. In this multidisciplinary environment, you'll leverage deep technical expertise with business acumen to help clients tackle their most transformative challenges. You'll work on integrated teams alongside our general consultants and clients to develop data-driven strategies and innovative solutions. Together, we create human-centric solutions that harness the power of data and artificial intelligence to drive competitive advantage for our clients. Our collaborative and supportive work environment fosters creativity and continuous learning, enabling us to consistently deliver exceptional results. Where you'll fit within the team As a Lead Machine Learning Engineer, you'll help drive innovation by integrating AI and data-driven solutions into strategy and execution. Whether launching new ventures, reimagining user experiences, or building tech-enabled products, you'll work at the intersection of analytics and impact - turning bold strategies into breakthrough results. Bain offers comprehensive benefits and flexible policies that are designed to support you, so you can thrive personally and professionally. What you'll do Design, build, and deliver statistical/ML models and agentic AI/LLM solutions to solve high-impact client problems. Architect and implement production-grade ML systems by building enterprise-grade services, applying MLOps and CI/CD for reliable deployment and monitoring, and ensuring high standards in engineering quality and documentation. Partner with general consulting teams and client stakeholders to translate business problems into ML solutions, prioritize work, and enable enterprise-scale AI transformation. Continuously research emerging frameworks and state-of-the-art AI (e.g., LLMs, agents, retrieval, post-training, etc.) and convert learnings into reusable frameworks, components, and accelerators used across industries and functions. Share knowledge and mentor others on best practices tools, and approaches in applied machine learning and AI engineering. Contribute to internal RD and learning initiatives to advance Bain's AI capabilities and foster continuous innovation between projects. Qualifications 5+ years of relevant experience or an advanced degree Strong theoretical and practical experience in machine learning Proficiency in Python, with solid software engineering foundations - including clean code practices, testing, version control. Experience with data wrangling, data analysis and modeling using Python, SQL, PySpark or similar tools Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure) and deploying ML/AI applications. Comprehensive understanding of the ML lifecycle, from experimentation and model development to deployment. Experience productionizing and exposing ML models (e.g., using FastAPI, Flask, or similar frameworks) for seamless integration into applications and platforms. Excellent communicator and collaborator, able to align with technical and business stakeholders in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. Curious and growth-oriented, passionate about exploring new tools, mentoring peers, and sharing best practices. Adaptable and self-driven, comfortable operating with autonomy, embracing feedback, and learning new skills to deliver client impact. Location: New Delhi, Bengaluru, Mumbai (Hybrid) Travel is required. This position requires regional travel. Travel frequency and destinations will vary based on project needs. Nice to Have Experience with RD or academic research Interest in publishing technical content and mentoring others Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying. 5-10 Yrs Machine, Data analysis, Python, Consulting, Science, GCP, Analysis, SQL
